question: Choose the correctly spelt word that means 'excessively talkative, especially on trivial matters'.
solution:
The correct answer is** option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **‘Garrulous’** is spelled correctly and means **‘excessively talkative, especially on trivial matters’**.
 
• It is derived from Latin **‘garrulus’**, meaning talkative.
 
• **Usage:** This word is often used to describe someone who speaks too much about unimportant things.

*Example Sentence:* The garrulous old man kept the children entertained with his endless stories.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2 (Garullous):** Incorrect spelling.
 
• **Option 3 (Garyulous):** Incorrect spelling.
 
• **Option 4 (Garrullus):** Incorrect spelling.
